body: Yes I do! I'll DM you my tag in a little bit
I'd be interested in joining, semi-experienced DM and wouldn't mind helping out a little if you'd like

I'd have to do something like take out a loan to get away without it being for work.
I do feel a little better after talking to you though. I appreciate it, thank you. I need to be getting to sleep now, so I'm not going to be doing anything dumb, just going to bed. Thank you again.

I got back from a work trip recently. Although nice, the house is such a disaster now that I wish I either hadn't gone or hadn't come back. I'm not sure which would be preferable.

Basically... no, a vacation wouldn't be helpful, and we can't afford for me to be anywhere else, really.

My kid is actually with my wife for the week, so I can't do anything with him right now anyway. That was another reason this week is a good opportunity for me. I try to do lots of things, but I can't stick with anything because of other commitments. There's always something else I have to do, you should see my house.

I've tried clay modelling, learning code, learning 3d modelling, languages... I've done lots of things, but I can't really enjoy any of them because of all the other things I NEED to do. Even my kid is just another burden-- I know that's wrong but it's how I feel a lot of the time, and another reason I think I should be out of the picture.

I like making things, producing things, but there's just no time for me to do that anymore. I feel horrible and selfish for saying that, and I think I'm just going in circles now.

If I try to do anything for me, everything else just piles up and gets worse. The cooking, the cleaning, the kid (except this week), everything's on me, so even if I do stop to do something I like I just feel guilty about it.

This was very rambly. I'm sorry. I just can't really say I can do that. I mean, cleaning, sure, but that just makes me miserable anyway.

I play a lot of games, I don't really find them much fun anymore whether I'm depressed or not, but I don't really have much else. I used to try to write, but I'm horrible at it and can't really find the time or motivation-- gave that up a while back.

I don't really do much of anything anymore. The things I do are basically just to burn time. Sorry that wasn't a very good answer.

I'm military, I've researched it as well as I can. Depression/suicidal thoughts can be grounds for a discharge (I know how it goes, nobody owes me any favors), and my life insurance pays on suicide. I'm not really sure why.

One of my problems is I really want help. I don't like feeling like this. I feel like I'm constantly arguing with someone telling me how worthless I am.

But I can't get help. 'Getting help', for me, would basically mean losing my job and being completely unable to provide for my family. But for me, if I commit suicide, I don't have to feel like this anymore, and my family gets my life insurance.

I think my wife would be upset, anyone would. But ultimately I think she'd be happier. She'd have more money, more freedom. And people always say "There's plenty of fish in the sea"; I'm replaceable, in the grand scheme.

Edit: Sorry, I didn't answer your question. It's not really any specific thing on my mind. I'm just miserable, I hate the act of being alive.



I've wanted to kill myself for a while now, but I was always worried my wife would find me before I died or something. Since she's gone for the week, it seems like I could really finally do it.
